title: The Mysterious Cosmic Signal That Disappeared
description: In 1977, astronomers detected a 72-second radio burst from deep space that was never heard again. What was the Wow! Signal? #Space #Mystery #Shorts

scenes.prompt: Cinematic slow pull-back shot from a colossal radio telescope observatory standing isolated beneath an expanse of starry night sky. Atmospheric blue dusk illumination, 8K ultra-detailed photorealistic.
scenes.voiceover_text: Tahun 1977, sebuah teleskop radio di Ohio menangkap gelombang aneh dari kedalaman galaksi.

scenes.prompt: Close-up cinematic macro tracking shot of continuous computer printout paper feeding through a 1970s mainframe terminal printer, printing alphanumeric columns in dark room. Vintage cinematic realism, 8K.
scenes.voiceover_text: Bukan derau biasa, melainkan lonjakan frekuensi radio murni yang sangat kuat.

scenes.prompt: Extreme macro shot of an astronomer's trembling hand holding a red pen, circling the code '6EQUJ5' and writing 'Wow!' on the margin. Soft warm desk lamp lighting, 8K.
scenes.voiceover_text: Astronom Jerry Ehman begitu terpana hingga menuliskan kata 'Wow!' dengan tinta merah di kertas hasil cetak itu.
